conceptual_change: Incorporate the ATR-based volatility-gate filter directly into the signal execution logic by requiring the current ATR(14) to be > 1.5 * SMA(ATR(14), 20) as a prerequisite for long/short entry triggers.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous attempt (BC 15) identified a strategy for filtering noise-driven false breakouts but failed due to lack of an explicit implementation. This hypothesis formalizes the condition as an actionable signal gate to test if volatility-based entry filtering improves precision.
